$comment: Game window sizes raid-actions accepts. Any size works: click targets come from memory rectangles that scale with the window. Refused only when minimized or smaller than minimumClient; then the window is restored / enlarged to minimumClient by itself, in place (not moved), and left at that size after the run. minimumClient keeps the smallest click target (champion tile, picker item) at least targetPx pixels at the game's aspect ratio, never below floorClient. Worked out by  RaidActions window minimum.
how: 2026-11-20: 896x504 (16:9): the game snaps a 864x486 request to 858x469 (below the minimum, the bot then refuses); 896x504 is taken exactly (checked live). Smallest target ~43 px.
